description: Website favicon configuration with dynamic options

type.description:
Favicon source type:
- 'github': Uses GitHub profile avatar as favicon
- 'custom': Uses custom image from customUrl
- 'icon': Uses React Icon as favicon (from react-icons.github.io)
- 'default': Uses browser default favicon

customUrl.description: Custom favicon URL (required when type is 'custom'). May be absolute or site-relative.

githubUsername.description: GitHub username for fetching profile image (overrides projects.devUsername for favicon only)

iconName.description: React Icon name from react-icons.github.io (e.g., FaReact, SiJavascript, MdHome). Visit https://react-icons.github.io/react-icons for available icons.

iconColor.description: Hex color for the icon (when type is 'icon')

backgroundColor.description: Background color for the icon favicon (hex color or 'transparent')

iconSize.description: Size of the generated icon favicon in pixels

sizes.description: Array of favicon sizes to generate for different platforms and devices

appleTouchIcon.description: Whether to generate Apple touch icons for iOS devices

note.description: Documentation note for favicon configuration guidance
